Document: # Rule 2.2 Do not commit major crimes as a non-antagonist without admin approval. AFTERLIGHT permits all players to commit minor crimes in an effort to support various story lines, however, it must be kept minimal and non-disruptive if you are doing it without the guidance of an admin. - As a rule of thumb, if it significantly harms anyone other than yourself, causes a public or work location to be unusable or unsafe, or involves the theft of irreplaceable gear such as command gear, you should ahelp before doing it. If you are unsure if what you're about to do is a minor or major crime, always ahelp first. - After you are caught and given punishment in-character, you are expected to severely limit the repetition of similar crimes. If other players begin to become annoyed or irritated because you continue to be a nuisance, you may be subject to punishment. - The arrivals station, arrivals shuttle, and end round Central Command station are entirely off-limits for antagonistic actions; do not grief, attack others, or do anything that could be considered antagonistic in these locations under any circumstance, even as an antagonist.
